command.label: sms-after-open-target
command.code:
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ANDROID_UIAUTOMATOR, 'new UiSelector().text("SMS Messenger")').click()
WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(lambda d: bool(d.find_elements(AppiumBy.ID, 'com.simplemobiletools.smsmessenger:id/no_conversations_placeholder_2')))
observe()
